usage: Check metadata registry; contains no code and does not establish that checks are implemented.

checks.title: Git repository detected
checks.applicability: any project directory
checks.verified_assertion: git rev-parse identifies a usable repository
checks.limitation: does not verify history quality

checks.title: Gitignore file detected
checks.applicability: project using Git
checks.limitation: does not ensure all secrets are excluded

checks.title: Git remote configured
checks.applicability: Git project; remote optional for local projects
checks.verified_assertion: git remote returns at least one remote
checks.required_evidence: remote names without tokens or secret-bearing URLs
checks.limitation: does not prove remote backup or access

checks.title: README found
checks.applicability: any project intended for maintenance
checks.verified_assertion: README file in a recognized format exists
checks.limitation: does not prove commands are accurate

checks.title: Runtime and dependency manifest
checks.applicability: identified Python or JS/TS project
checks.limitation: may not suit unknown stacks

checks.title: Dependency lockfile
checks.applicability: dependency manager for which a lockfile is expected
checks.limitation: does not guarantee perfectly reproducible installation

checks.title: Environment configuration example
checks.applicability: documented and detected use of environment variables
checks.limitation: do not read .env or print values

checks.title: Linter configuration detected
checks.applicability: stack supported by a linter
checks.verified_assertion: recognized linter configuration or script exists
checks.limitation: does not prove the linter passes

checks.title: Type-check configuration detected
checks.applicability: language or project with relevant static typing
checks.limitation: not universally required for plain JavaScript

checks.title: Test command or tool declared
checks.applicability: project with testable business logic
checks.limitation: does not indicate useful tests or a success rate

checks.title: Build command identified
checks.applicability: stack with a relevant build step
checks.limitation: a simple Python script may not have a build

checks.title: CI configuration detected
checks.applicability: shared or delivered repository, determinable from evidence
checks.limitation: does not prove a CI run succeeded

checks.title: Agent instructions detected (informational)
checks.applicability: agent instructions or an explicit agent workflow exists
checks.limitation: absence is not automatically a failure

checks.title: Potentially sensitive files tracked
checks.applicability: Git project
checks.verified_assertion: no tracked path matches the minimal known sensitive filename patterns
checks.required_evidence: reduced paths or category, no contents
checks.limitation: absence of suspect files does NOT mean absence of secrets

checks.title: Migration mechanism detected
checks.applicability: persistence and database schema identified with sufficient evidence
checks.verified_assertion: migration path or tool declaration identified
checks.limitation: migration safety remains unverified

checks.title: Backup strategy identified
checks.applicability: important persistent data with established applicability
checks.required_evidence: internal link or declared command without execution
checks.limitation: does not prove a successful backup or restoration

checks.title: MCP or external-tool declarations identified
checks.applicability: coding agent with detectable configuration files
checks.required_evidence: file path and count, sensitive values redacted
checks.limitation: does not itself audit permissions

checks.title: Linter execution
checks.applicability: linter configured and explicitly authorized
checks.required_evidence: command, version, exit code, reduced logs
checks.limitation: potentially active execution of project or plugin code

checks.title: Type-check execution
checks.applicability: relevant type check configured and explicitly authorized
checks.required_evidence: command, version, exit code, reduced logs
checks.limitation: may generate caches and read configuration

checks.title: Test suite execution
checks.applicability: known suite and explicit authorization
checks.required_evidence: command, exit code, test count if available
checks.limitation: tests may affect files or network and do not prove all logic

checks.title: Build execution
checks.applicability: applicable build step and explicit authorization
checks.limitation: build can write files and execute hooks

checks.title: Known dependency vulnerabilities
checks.applicability: compatible lockfile and installed scanner, with authorized execution
checks.limitation: often needs network; alerts do not establish exploitability

checks.title: Backup restoration actually verified
checks.applicability: valuable persistent data
checks.verified_assertion: actual evidence of restoration outside production
checks.required_evidence: dated report or checksum if available
checks.limitation: never automatically run destructive restoration
